words.note: 當 lockdown 強調政府或機構限制人們外出、跨區移動或進入某些地方時，可用 movement restrictions。這是較正式、客觀的說法。
words.example: Movement restrictions were introduced across the region.
words.exampleZh: 該地區實施了出行限制。

exercises.original: During the lockdown, residents were not allowed to travel outside their district without permission.
exercises.zh: 封鎖期間，居民未經許可不得離開所屬地區。
exercises.upgrade: movement restrictions · 出行限制；活動限制

options.explanation: movement restrictions = 出行限制。not allowed to travel outside their district 是最直接線索，重點是限制移動。
shutdown = 停擺／關閉。通常指機構、經濟活動或設施停止運作，不專指個人出行。
curfew = 宵禁。只限制特定時段外出，不等於整體地區移動限制。
quarantine = 隔離。通常針對可能接觸疾病的人或特定群體，不是整體移動規則。
closure = 關閉。適合學校、商店、道路等被關閉，不表示居民出行本身受限。
stay-at-home period = 居家令期間。意思接近，但本句最明確是跨區移動受限。

exercises.original: The government eased the lockdown by allowing people to travel between cities again.
exercises.zh: 政府放寬封鎖措施，重新允許人們在城市之間出行。
exercises.upgrade: movement restrictions · 出行限制；活動限制

options.explanation: business closures = 商業場所關閉。和城市間出行無直接關係。
movement restrictions = 出行限制。allowing people to travel between cities again 清楚表示限制的是移動。
quarantine rules = 隔離規則。通常涉及特定暴露人士或入境者。
school shutdowns = 學校停課。不是城市間移動。
curfew hours = 宵禁時段。重點是時間，不是跨城旅行。
emergency leave = 緊急假期。無關。

exercises.original: Strict lockdown rules limited travel between provinces for several weeks.
exercises.zh: 嚴格封鎖措施令省份之間的出行受限數星期。
exercises.upgrade: movement restrictions · 出行限制；活動限制

options.explanation: movement restrictions = 出行限制。limited travel between provinces 是典型正式搭配。
shutdowns = 停擺。通常指服務、企業或系統停止。
closures = 關閉。描述地點或設施被關閉。
isolation = 隔離。偏向個人或群體分開。
suspensions = 暫停。需明確說明哪項活動被暫停。
curfews = 宵禁。通常是特定時段限制外出。

words.note: 當 lockdown 的重點是人們被要求留在家中、除必要活動外不得外出時，可用 stay-at-home period。比 lockdown 更描述性。
words.example: Many people worked remotely during the stay-at-home period.
words.exampleZh: 居家限制期間，很多人遙距工作。

exercises.original: During the lockdown, people were asked to remain at home except for essential shopping and medical care.
exercises.zh: 封鎖期間，人們被要求留在家中，除必要購物和醫療外不得外出。
exercises.upgrade: stay-at-home period · 居家期間；居家限制期

options.explanation: stay-at-home period = 居家限制期。remain at home except for essential activities 是決定性線索。
shutdown = 停擺。只表示活動停止，不直接表示居民要留在家。
curfew = 宵禁。通常只在特定時間限制外出。
border closure = 邊境關閉。限制跨境，不等於留家。
quarantine ward = 隔離病房。完全不同。
work stoppage = 停工。只涉及工作活動。

exercises.original: Schools taught online throughout the lockdown because families were required to stay at home.
exercises.zh: 由於家庭被要求留在家中，學校在整個居家限制期進行網上教學。
exercises.upgrade: stay-at-home period · 居家期間；居家限制期

options.explanation: shutdown = 停擺。學校其實仍在線上運作，因此不完全是 shutdown。
stay-at-home period = 居家限制期。families were required to stay at home 是最直接線索。
border restriction = 邊境限制。與家庭留家無關。
curfew period = 宵禁期。通常只是某些時段不得外出。
quarantine case = 隔離個案。不是一段全社會時期。
closure order = 關閉令。可以關閉學校或商店，但不一定要求所有家庭留家。

exercises.original: Many people took up home exercise during the lockdown because they could leave only for essential reasons.
exercises.zh: 封鎖期間，很多人開始在家運動，因為他們只能因必要理由外出。
exercises.upgrade: stay-at-home period · 居家期間；居家限制期

options.explanation: stay-at-home period = 居家限制期。could leave only for essential reasons 明確指居家令。
business closure = 商業場所關閉。不是居民行動要求。
school shutdown = 學校停課。範圍太窄。
border control = 邊境管制。無關。
night curfew = 夜間宵禁。只限制夜晚。
quarantine facility = 隔離設施。無關。

words.note: 當 lockdown 強調企業、服務、產業或整體活動被迫停止運作時，可用 shutdown。它不一定表示人們被要求留家。
words.example: The factory shutdown lasted three weeks.
words.exampleZh: 工廠停工持續了三星期。

exercises.original: The lockdown forced factories, offices, and entertainment venues to stop operating.
exercises.zh: 封鎖措施迫使工廠、辦公室和娛樂場所停止運作。
exercises.upgrade: shutdown · 停擺；關閉；停止運作

options.explanation: shutdown = 停擺／關閉。factories, offices, venues stop operating 表示經濟和設施活動停止。
movement restriction = 出行限制。重點不是個人移動，而是機構停止運作。
stay-at-home period = 居家限制期。居民是否留家並非這句核心。
curfew = 宵禁。只涉及特定時段外出。
quarantine = 隔離。通常針對特定人群。
border control = 邊境管制。無關。

exercises.original: The restaurant survived the lockdown by switching entirely to delivery service.
exercises.zh: 餐廳在停擺期間靠全面轉做外送服務維持營運。
exercises.upgrade: shutdown · 停擺；關閉；停止運作

options.explanation: curfew = 宵禁。餐廳經營受限可能受宵禁影響，但這句重點是整體營運停止／轉型。
shutdown = 停擺。restaurant survived by switching to delivery 說明正常營業被中止。
quarantine = 隔離。不是餐廳營運概念。
movement controls = 移動管制。較偏居民外出。
stay-home order only = 僅居家令。語義太窄。
travel ban = 旅行禁令。與餐廳營運不直接。

exercises.original: The lockdown caused a temporary halt in nonessential manufacturing.
exercises.zh: 封鎖令非必要製造業暫時停擺。
exercises.upgrade: shutdown · 停擺；關閉；停止運作

options.explanation: shutdown = 停擺。temporary halt in manufacturing 正是 shutdown 的核心。
curfew = 宵禁。不是工業停工本身。
quarantine = 隔離。無關。
home confinement = 居家限制。只描述個人行動。
border closure = 邊境關閉。不是製造活動。
travel restriction = 出行限制。範圍不同。

words.note: 當 lockdown 指某些場所、設施或機構被關閉時，可用 closure。通常需要上下文指出是 school closure、business closure、venue closure 等。
words.example: The closure of gyms lasted several months.
words.exampleZh: 健身室關閉持續了數月。

exercises.original: The lockdown of schools lasted until remote learning systems were ready.
exercises.zh: 學校關閉一直持續到遙距教學系統準備好為止。
exercises.upgrade: closure · 關閉；停業

options.explanation: closure = 關閉。schools + remote learning 表示實體校園關閉。
curfew = 宵禁。不是學校停課。
quarantine = 隔離。不是設施關閉。
movement restriction = 出行限制。範圍不同。
isolation = 隔離。通常指人分開。
travel ban = 旅行禁令。無關。

exercises.original: The lockdown of cinemas and theaters had a major effect on the entertainment industry.
exercises.zh: 戲院和劇院關閉對娛樂業造成重大影響。
exercises.upgrade: closure · 關閉；停業

options.explanation: stay-at-home period = 居家限制期。太廣，這句特別談場所關閉。
closure = 關閉。cinemas and theaters 是具體設施，closure 最精準。
quarantine = 隔離。無關。
curfew = 宵禁。不是場所長期關閉本身。
border shutdown = 邊境關閉。地點錯誤。
movement restriction = 出行限制。不是設施狀態。

exercises.original: The temporary lockdown of the library ended once safety measures were in place.
exercises.zh: 安全措施到位後，圖書館的暫時關閉結束。
exercises.upgrade: closure · 關閉；停業

options.explanation: closure = 關閉。library 是具體設施，temporary closure 是最自然搭配。
quarantine = 隔離。通常不是形容圖書館。
curfew = 宵禁。不是設施狀態。
home confinement = 居家限制。不是圖書館。
travel restriction = 出行限制。無關。
isolation period = 隔離期。無關。

words.note: 比 stay-at-home period 更強調正式規定或命令，表示政府或主管機關要求居民除必要理由外留在家中。
words.example: A stay-at-home order was issued for the entire city.

exercises.original: The lockdown required residents to remain at home except for food, medicine, and essential work.
exercises.zh: 居家令要求居民除購買食物、藥物和必要工作外都要留在家中。
exercises.upgrade: stay-at-home order · 居家令；居家命令

options.explanation: stay-at-home order = 居家令。required residents to remain at home 是最直接的法律／行政命令語境。
business closure = 商業關閉。不是對居民本人的要求。
curfew = 宵禁。通常只限某些時段。
border control = 邊境管制。無關。
quarantine notice = 隔離通知。多針對特定人士。
school closure = 學校關閉。範圍太窄。

exercises.original: Authorities issued a lockdown telling everyone to stay home unless they had an essential reason to go out.
exercises.zh: 當局頒布居家令，要求所有人除非有必要理由，否則留在家中。
exercises.upgrade: stay-at-home order · 居家令；居家命令

options.explanation: movement guidance = 出行指引。guidance 語氣太弱，題目是 authorities issued 且要求所有人遵守。
stay-at-home order = 居家令。issued + telling everyone to stay home 是標準搭配。
shutdown = 停擺。不是一項針對居民外出的正式命令名稱。
curfew hours = 宵禁時段。不是全天居家。
quarantine case = 隔離個案。無關。
venue closure = 場所關閉。不是居民命令。

exercises.original: The city lifted its lockdown after infection rates fell for several weeks.
exercises.zh: 感染率連續數星期下降後，城市解除居家令。
exercises.upgrade: stay-at-home order · 居家令；居家命令

options.explanation: stay-at-home order = 居家令。city lifted its ... 是典型行政措施搭配。
school closure = 學校關閉。範圍太窄。
business shutdown only = 只限商業停業。不是全市居民措施。
border closure = 邊境關閉。無關。
night curfew only = 僅夜間宵禁。比 lockdown 窄。
quarantine ward = 隔離病房。完全不同。

words.note: 較正式，強調人被限制在某個地方、活動範圍受限。用於 lockdown 時常見 home confinement 或 periods of confinement。
words.example: Many people found prolonged confinement psychologically difficult.
words.exampleZh: 很多人覺得長期受限制在家中在心理上很難受。

exercises.original: The long lockdown left many older residents feeling isolated at home.
exercises.zh: 長期封鎖令很多年長居民因長時間受限在家而感到孤立。
exercises.upgrade: confinement · 限制外出；受限制狀態

options.explanation: confinement = 受限制狀態。feeling isolated at home 強調長時間被限制在家。
closure = 關閉。通常指場所或設施。
shutdown = 停擺。通常指活動或機構停止。
curfew = 宵禁。只限某些時段。
quarantine case = 隔離個案。不是整體生活狀態。
travel ban = 旅行禁令。比居家限制窄。

exercises.original: Weeks of lockdown were especially difficult for people living alone in small apartments.
exercises.zh: 數星期的居家限制對獨居於小型公寓的人尤其難熬。
exercises.upgrade: confinement · 限制外出；受限制狀態

options.explanation: closure = 關閉。不是人的生活狀態。
confinement = 受限制狀態。living alone in small apartments 強調長期被限制在有限空間。
shutdown = 停擺。較適合商業或系統。
border control = 邊境管制。無關。
school closure = 學校停課。無關。
curfew hours = 宵禁時段。沒有全天限制的意味。

exercises.original: Prolonged lockdown affected people's routines, exercise, and social contact.
exercises.zh: 長期受限制在家影響了人們的日常作息、運動和社交接觸。
exercises.upgrade: confinement · 限制外出；受限制狀態

options.explanation: confinement = 長期受限制。routines, exercise, social contact 都是人在受限生活狀態下受影響的層面。
business closure = 商業場所關閉。範圍太窄。
border restriction = 邊境限制。無關。
night curfew = 夜間宵禁。時間太窄。
school shutdown = 學校停課。範圍太窄。
quarantine ward = 隔離病房。無關。

words.note: 當 lockdown 實際由多項規則組成，例如人數限制、營業限制、旅行限制等，可用 restrictions。這是較廣泛、中性的概括詞。
words.example: The restrictions were gradually relaxed over several months.
words.exampleZh: 限制措施在數月內逐步放寬。

exercises.original: The lockdown included limits on gatherings, travel, and business opening hours.
exercises.zh: 封鎖措施包括聚會、出行和商戶營業時間限制。
exercises.upgrade: restrictions · 限制措施；管制措施

options.explanation: restrictions = 限制措施。gatherings, travel, opening hours 顯示這是一組不同規則的總稱。
shutdown = 停擺。不能涵蓋仍然開放但受時間限制的活動。
curfew = 宵禁。只是一種時間限制。
quarantine = 隔離。只是其中可能一項措施。
closure = 關閉。不能涵蓋聚會人數和旅行限制。
isolation = 隔離。不是多項政策的總稱。

exercises.original: The country gradually relaxed its lockdown as vaccination rates increased.
exercises.zh: 隨着疫苗接種率上升，該國逐步放寬限制措施。
exercises.upgrade: restrictions · 限制措施；管制措施

options.explanation: closures only = 只有關閉措施。太窄。
restrictions = 限制措施。gradually relaxed 是政策組合最常見的搭配。
quarantine cases = 隔離個案。不是政策總稱。
curfew nights = 宵禁夜晚。語義不自然且過窄。
border shutdown = 邊境關閉。只是其中一種措施。
home isolation = 居家隔離。不是所有限制。

exercises.original: People found it difficult to keep track of changing lockdown rules.
exercises.zh: 人們覺得很難掌握不斷改變的限制措施。
exercises.upgrade: restrictions · 限制措施；管制措施

options.explanation: restrictions = 限制措施。changing rules 明確是一組不斷變化的規定。
shutdown = 停擺。不是規則本身。
closure = 關閉。只是一種措施。
quarantine = 隔離。太窄。
curfew = 宵禁。太窄。
confinement only = 只指受限制狀態。不能涵蓋所有 changing rules。

words.meaning: 封閉期；限制進出期（特定場所）
words.note: 只適合特定場所或機構被限制進出、所有人暫時留在內部的情況。它不是一般公共政策 lockdown 的普遍替代詞，但在校園、設施或特定場地語境中可用。
words.example: The facility entered a temporary lock-in period after the security alert.
words.exampleZh: 保安警報後，該設施進入暫時限制進出期。

exercises.original: The campus lockdown required everyone already inside the building to remain there until the security threat was cleared.
exercises.zh: 校園封鎖要求所有已在建築物內的人留在原地，直到保安威脅解除。
exercises.upgrade: lock-in period · 封閉期；限制進出期（特定場所）

options.explanation: lock-in period = 限制進出期。everyone already inside must remain there + security threat 表示特定設施內部封閉。
stay-at-home period = 居家限制期。這裡不是要求回家，而是留在建築內。
economic shutdown = 經濟停擺。無關。
border closure = 邊境關閉。地理範圍錯誤。
travel restriction = 出行限制。太廣，沒有『留在設施內』意味。
quarantine case = 隔離個案。不是保安封鎖。

exercises.original: During the prison lockdown, inmates remained in their housing units and movement inside the facility was restricted.
exercises.zh: 監獄封鎖期間，囚犯留在各自住宿單位，設施內活動受到限制。
exercises.upgrade: lock-in period · 封閉期；限制進出期（特定場所）

options.explanation: stay-at-home order = 居家令。監獄不是一般家庭住所。
lock-in period = 封閉期。inmates remained in units + internal movement restricted 是特定設施限制進出的典型情況。
business closure = 商業關閉。無關。
border control = 邊境管制。無關。
public curfew = 公共宵禁。不是監獄內部措施。
school shutdown = 學校停課。無關。

exercises.original: The hospital lockdown kept visitors out and required some staff to remain inside until the emergency ended.
exercises.zh: 醫院封鎖期間，訪客不得進入，部分員工亦須留在院內直至緊急情況結束。
exercises.upgrade: lock-in period · 封閉期；限制進出期（特定場所）

options.explanation: lock-in period = 限制進出期。visitors kept out + staff remain inside 是特定場所封閉。
stay-at-home period = 居家限制期。不是要求員工回家。
citywide restrictions = 全市限制。範圍過大。
economic shutdown = 經濟停擺。無關。
night curfew = 夜間宵禁。無關。
travel ban = 旅行禁令。不是設施內外出入控制。

falseSynonyms.zh: 隔離不等於一般的 lockdown quarantine = 隔離 quarantine 通常針對可能接觸傳染病的人、動物或貨物，在指定時間與他人分開。lockdown 可以是全社會或某場所的廣泛限制，概念更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Quarantine isolates specific people or groups; a lockdown may restrict an entire area.

falseSynonyms.zh: 宵禁不等於一般的 lockdown curfew = 宵禁 curfew 是在特定時段禁止或限制外出，通常是晚上。lockdown 可以全天、跨多日，並包括更多措施。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A curfew restricts movement at certain hours; a lockdown can be much broader.

falseSynonyms.zh: 隔離；孤立不等於一般的 lockdown isolation = 隔離；孤立 isolation 通常指個人與他人分開，可能是醫療或社會層面的；它不是整體 lockdown 政策的通用同義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Isolation concerns separation; lockdown concerns wider restrictions.

falseSynonyms.zh: 關閉不等於一般的 lockdown closure = 關閉 closure 只表示某個地方、設施或機構被關閉。它可以是 lockdown 的一部分，但不代表所有封鎖措施。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A school closure may occur during a lockdown.

falseSynonyms.zh: 旅行禁令不等於一般的 lockdown travel ban = 旅行禁令 travel ban 只限制特定旅行或跨境移動，範圍通常比 lockdown 窄。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A travel ban restricts travel; a lockdown may also restrict work, gatherings, and businesses.

falseSynonyms.zh: 緊急狀態；緊急事件不等於一般的 lockdown emergency = 緊急狀態；緊急事件 emergency 是導致措施出現的情況，不是 lockdown 措施本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An emergency may lead to a lockdown.

falseSynonyms.zh: 停工／拒絕進入不等於一般的 lockdown lockout = 停工／拒絕進入 lockout 常指僱主把員工拒於工作場所之外，或系統把使用者鎖定在外。它和 lockdown 只是拼字相近。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A lockout keeps people out; a lockdown restricts movement or operations.

falseSynonyms.zh: 鎖上；把人關起來不等於一般的 lockdown lock up = 鎖上；把人關起來 lock up 是動詞片語，表示把某物鎖好或把某人關押。它不是名詞 lockdown 的直接替代。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They locked up the building. The city entered a lockdown.
